body:
Owning issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/396
Owner requested parallel implementation on 2026-09-30. Original issue intent follows; repository contracts and accepted authority remain governing.

## Summary

Provide the **evidence that lets a post-merge workflow earn automation** one content class at a time. Corvint supplies the evidence; the owner decides.

## Requested capability

- **Per-run metrics records.** Each records the outcome for each stage and the time taken to create the follow-up item. For a generated change request, it records how much humans edited it after the bot's last commit, measured in lines and files. It also records reverts and later corrections of generated content, findings closed as invalid, and containment-guard trips.
- **Content classes** defined by policy. Examples: "no-change records", "provenance or anchor-only updates", "flow prose", "new end-to-end tests", "corpus republish".
- **A report** that shows correction rates per class over a window, compared with policy thresholds and demotion rules (for example, any revert drops the class back to review for N runs).

## Constraints

- Corvint emits a recommendation and grants no authority, as in decision 0081 and the 0373 authority rules. Flipping a class to automatic merge is an owner-reviewed policy change.

## Acceptance

- The report is reproducible from the stored records.
- The policy file is validated.
- A demotion is triggered by a fixture revert.


Part of #388.
title: GH #396: Feature: per-content-class evidence for earning automated merge
